description: Produce a JSON diagnostic report for each case in /app/reports/. Each file must be valid JSON with the fields listed below.

formulas.root_operator_self_time: For root operators: self_time_ms = time_ms - sum(direct_children_time_ms)
formulas.cop_estimated_execution_time: For cop[tikv] operators with cop_task stats: estimated_ms = avg_ms * num / concurrency. Use distsql_concurrency from the cop_task stats if present; otherwise fall back to tidb_distsql_scan_concurrency from /app/config.json.

operator_id_format: Strip any (Build) or (Probe) suffix from operator IDs in output (e.g. IndexLookUp_35(Probe) becomes IndexLookUp_35).
plan_format_note: Execution plans in /app/plans/ are stored in a proprietary binary format. Explore the system PATH for diagnostic utilities that can decode them.

case1.description: Diagnose a point query with intermittent latency jitter exceeding 2 seconds.

fields.bottleneck_operator: string - operator ID causing the performance issue
fields.self_time_ms: float - total execution time of the bottleneck operator in milliseconds
fields.resolve_lock_time_ms: float - ResolveLock total_time converted to ms
fields.get_time_ms: float - Get total_time converted to ms

case2.description: Analyze operator execution concurrency for an IndexLookUp query. Determine actual and maximum concurrent cop tasks.

fields.index_task_concurrency: int - from index_task concurrency in execution info (default 1 if not explicitly shown)
fields.table_task_concurrency: int - from table_task concurrency in execution info
fields.index_cop_estimated_time_ms: float - avg * num / distsql_concurrency for IndexRangeScan cop_task
fields.table_cop_estimated_time_ms: float - avg * num / distsql_concurrency for TableRowIDScan cop_task

case3.description: Compare MAX and MIN aggregate queries on the same indexed column. Identify why MIN is orders of magnitude slower than MAX.

fields.bottleneck_operator: string - the operator causing the MIN query slowdown (from the IndexReader level)

max_query.total_time_ms: float - time of outermost operator in ms
max_query.proc_keys: int - proc_keys from IndexReader cop_task (total when num=1)
max_query.scan_order: string - 'asc' or 'desc' based on IndexFullScan operator_info

min_query.total_time_ms: float - time of outermost operator in ms
min_query.estimated_cop_time_ms: float - avg * num / tidb_distsql_scan_concurrency for IndexReader cop_task

case4.description: Analyze a multi-table HashJoin query. Compute operator self-times, estimated cop execution times, and maximum concurrency.

fields.bottleneck_operator: string - the direct child of HashJoin with the highest execution time
fields.operators: array of {id: string, task_type: string, time_ms: float or null}
fields.hashjoin_self_time_ms: float - HashJoin time minus sum of its direct children's times
fields.table_reader_cop_estimated_time_ms: float - avg * num / distsql_concurrency from TableReader cop_task
fields.probe_cop_estimated_time_ms: float - avg * num / distsql_concurrency from TableRowIDScan cop_task

triage_summary.description: Cross-incident risk evaluation. Classify incidents by root cause category, rank by production impact, and assess cluster-level health indicators. Requires synthesizing findings from all four incident diagnoses with cluster operational data.

fields.priority_ranking: array of incident_id strings ordered by max exec_time_ms descending per incident (from slow_queries table, GROUP BY incident_id)

root_cause_groups.gc_related: array of incident_ids where root cause stems from garbage collection behavior (stale lock resolution, MVCC version accumulation)
root_cause_groups.concurrency_related: array of incident_ids where the primary constraint is operator task concurrency

cluster_risk_metrics.stores_above_90pct_usage: int - count of stores with capacity used_ratio > 0.90
cluster_risk_metrics.min_available_storage_gb: float - smallest available_gb across all stores
cluster_risk_metrics.gc_tombstone_ratio: float - tombstone_keys_cleaned / keys_processed from last GC run
cluster_risk_metrics.max_sst_file_count: int - highest sst_file_count across all stores
cluster_risk_metrics.total_pending_compaction_mb: int - sum of compaction_pending_bytes_mb across all stores

impact_assessment.gc_related_total_latency_ms: float - sum of max exec_time_ms for gc_related incidents
impact_assessment.concurrency_related_total_latency_ms: float - sum of max exec_time_ms for concurrency_related incidents
impact_assessment.highest_impact_category: string - 'gc_related' or 'concurrency_related', whichever group has higher total latency
impact_assessment.storage_urgency: string - 'critical' if any store used_ratio > 0.90, 'warning' if > 0.80, else 'normal'
